problem: Harden Simsimmer GitHub Actions and repair the scheduled ratchet synchronization boundary without misclassifying the observed zero-step hosted-runner failure as a repository test failure.
success_criteria: external actions use current Node 24-compatible releases pinned to full commit SHAs
the ratchet lane is checked for state-only divergence before repository code executes
main/ratchet divergence synchronizes without history rewriting and fails closed on conflicts
autoresearch cannot silently create commits or persist non-state changes
CI enforces the action-pinning and containment contract
the pre-step hosted-runner incident remains explicitly separated from repository-controlled failures
verification: simulate branch histories: ratchet behind main; ratchet state ahead plus main code ahead; non-state ratchet drift; conflicting state edits
run repository CI commands through GitHub Actions when hosted runners execute steps
residuals: GitHub-hosted runner entitlement, billing, repository Actions settings, or platform storage failures are outside repository code and require a normal hosted job to disambiguate
